blocks.text: Dedication to Community: Black Pearl Painters Set the Standard

At Black Pearl Painters, we believe painting is more than transforming walls; it’s about building relationships, brightening lives, and investing in the places we call home. That’s why, beyond bringing quality painting services to homeowners and businesses, we are committed to being an active part of our community. Over the past year, we’ve had the privilege of supporting and participating in several incredible events that reflect the heart and soul of our company: giving back, having fun, and standing shoulder to shoulder with our neighbors.

From raising awareness and funding for childhood cancer research, to celebrating music and small businesses at local festivals, to stepping onto the “driving range” with a country twist, our team has been honored to join in. Here’s a closer look at three events that hold a special place in our hearts.

blocks.title: Building Colorful Connections: Black Pearl Painters’ Dedication To Community

blocks.text: Standing Strong for Childhood Cancer Research with The Stenson Foundation

One of the most meaningful opportunities we’ve had was sponsoring an event for The Stenson Foundation, an organization dedicated to childhood cancer research. This cause is deeply personal for us: we are extended family to Charlie Stenson, a brave and inspiring young fighter who has been facing cancer since she was just three years old.

Today, Charlie is celebrating her second remission; a milestone that fills us with gratitude and hope. Her resilience, along with the determination of her family, is nothing short of extraordinary. Their dedication to raising awareness and funds has created ripples far beyond their own circle. In fact, at this year’s event, the Stenson Foundation raised more than $200,000 to support research and treatment for children battling cancer.

Being part of this event wasn’t just about writing a check or putting our name on a banner. For our team, it was about standing with Charlie, her family, and countless others who face the unimaginable. It was about celebrating victories, big and small, and committing ourselves to the fight against childhood cancer.
At Black Pearl Painters, we know the power of color to change a room, but it’s causes like these that truly bring color and light into people’s lives.

blocks.title: Building Colorful Connections: Black Pearl Painters’ Dedication To Community

blocks.text: Tunes at Tapps: Supporting Local Music and Small Businesses

Our community is more than just neighborhoods and streets; it’s a living, breathing place full of creativity, energy, and connection. That’s why we were thrilled to be part of Tunes at Tapps, a vibrant summer tradition held at Allan Yorke Park on Wednesday evenings throughout July and August.
This event combines everything we love about living and working here:

items: Live music that gets people dancing and singing along.
Local vendors showcasing handmade goods, fresh foods, and unique treasures.
Families and friends gathered together, enjoying warm evenings by the lake.

blocks.text: For us, being part of Tunes at Tapps was about more than sponsoring—it was about joining in the celebration of what makes our community so special. We loved seeing familiar faces, meeting new ones, and sharing in the joy of an event that lifts local artists and small businesses.
As painters, we understand the importance of creativity. Supporting musicians, makers, and entrepreneurs in our area is just another way we invest in the colorful spirit of our hometown.

blocks.title: Building Colorful Connections: Black Pearl Painters’ Dedication To Community

blocks.text: Rhinestones, Fringe, and Fairways: A Community Golf Tournament with a Twist
And then, of course, there was the golf tournament. But this wasn’t your typical day on the greens. Oh no, this was the rootin’-tootin’-honky-tonk, country-glam showdown of the season!

Participants showed up in true Dollywood-meets-CMA fashion: bedazzled cowboy hats, fringed jeans, sparkling belt buckles, and enough rhinestones to light up the course. While the official rules said, “no boots on the greens,” that didn’t stop the fun. Between long drives (and longnecks), laughter, and a little friendly competition, it was a day to remember.

For us, it was more than just hitting a few balls, it was about supporting a local event that brought people together with humor, heart, and a whole lot of western swagger. Community is built when people laugh, cheer, and spend time side by side, and this event was the perfect example of that.
Why Community Matters to Black Pearl Painters

At Black Pearl Painters, we believe in doing things the right way, whether that’s prepping a wall for a flawless finish or showing up to support causes and events that matter to our neighbors. Our business may be painting, but our purpose is people.
Here’s what community involvement means to us:

items: Connection. Every project we take on is about more than painting; it’s about building trust with homeowners, businesses, and organizations. Events like these give us another chance to strengthen those bonds.
Support. Whether it’s raising money for childhood cancer research or celebrating local talent, we want to invest in what helps our community thrive.
Joy. Life can be stressful, but events like Tunes at Tapps or a rhinestone-filled golf tournament remind us all to laugh, relax, and enjoy the moment.

blocks.text: We’re proud to call this community our home, and we’re committed to giving back in meaningful ways.
Looking Ahead

As we reflect on these incredible events, we feel grateful for the opportunities we’ve had to join hands with our neighbors and make a difference. But we’re not stopping here. At Black Pearl Painters, we’re already looking forward to the next opportunity to contribute, celebrate, and connect.
Because at the end of the day, painting is our craft, but community is our calling.

If you see us at the next local festival, charity fundraiser, or family-friendly event, don’t be shy! Stop by, say hello, and share your story with us. After all, the more connections we make, the brighter and more colorful our community becomes.
